description: This file is a shell script used for testing the integration between git and CVS, specifically testing git-cvsserver and refspecs handling. It contains setup routines, test case definitions, and commands to verify CVS and git operations, such as checkout, commit, diff, merge, and branch operations.

methods.name: check_start_tree
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by removing previous expectations and logs the start of a directory tree check.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Verifies the content of a specific file at a given git revision matches the expected sandbox content by checking the file's output against the expected.

methods.name: check_end_tree
methods.description: Confirms that the directory structure of the checked sandbox matches the expected structure.

methods.name: check_end_full_tree
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive verification including directory structure, file listing, and git tree listing to ensure the sandbox matches the expected state.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Applies a diff file to a sandbox and verifies the change corresponds to the specified old and new versions.
